sources.title: DefiLlama — Derive protocol page: monthly fees, revenue, holders revenue, TVL (only values dated on or before 30 Apr 2026 used)
sources.excerpt: Monthly revenue (fees net of maker rebates): Nov-25 $133,203; Dec-25 $134,235; Jan-26 $236,884; Feb-26 $152,228; Mar-26 $479,121; Apr-26 $395,482. Fees Feb–Apr 2026: $247,270 / $708,611 / $550,570. Holders revenue (DRV buybacks) Feb–Apr 2026: $74,794 / $150,124 / $78,096. TVL month-end: 31 Jan $66.77M, 28 Feb $69.02M, 31 Mar $99.82M, 30 Apr $121.79M. Funding listed: $3.3M seed (2021), $3M strategic (2022), Variant round (Feb 2026). No audits listed on the page.

sources.title: Derive insights (reproducing FalconX post) — Exploring Derive's record options surge (13 Mar 2026)
sources.excerpt: Record $294M options volume in week to 7 Mar 2026; Feb 2026 volume >$1B notional; total OI >$1B on 10 Mar (61% options); largest-ever trade a $130M+ BTC options structure; daily options volume ~8.0% of Deribit's; Derive 0.8% of BTC options OI across venues (~$63B, Coin Metrics). FalconX among onboarded market makers; RFQ blocks up to 1,000 BTC; off-exchange custody added in 2026.

sources.title: Derive insights — Variant invests in Derive (2 Feb 2026)
sources.excerpt: Variant holds a significant DRV position via open-market purchases and a Foundation transaction; amount and price undisclosed. Claims: >$20B trading volume, >$7M revenue, five years live with zero security or insolvency incidents, 20+ teams building on Derive, majority of on-chain options OI, FalconX market-making since 2024.

sources.title: The Block — Synthetix and Derive call off $27 million merger proposal (26 May 2025)
sources.excerpt: Proposed 27 DRV : 1 SNX swap valued Derive at $27M; withdrawn after Derive holders argued it undervalued a protocol whose recent revenue exceeded Synthetix's.

sources.title: Cointelegraph — Synthetix cans $27M Derive deal after community concerns (22 May 2025)
sources.excerpt: Lyra started in 2021 inside the Synthetix ecosystem as a decentralised options protocol, later rebranded to Derive and became independent of sUSD and Synthetix liquidity.

sources.title: Alea Research — Derive thesis (25 Jun 2025, public teaser)
sources.excerpt: FDV under $30M; annualised fees ~$3M; 25% of fees to DRV buybacks. OP Stack rollup with off-chain millisecond matching, portfolio margin, multi-collateral; 10+ active market makers. Founders' background in equity options and market making; in crypto since 2021. Risks: complex products, sticky CEX liquidity, failed SNX merger.

sources.title: Bankless — Your options for options (24 Jun 2025)
sources.excerpt: Deribit holds 87% of $46.8B crypto-native BTC+ETH options OI; Coinbase acquired Deribit for $2.9B. Derive: BTC/ETH options with daily to quarterly expiries, up to 60% lower margin on defined-risk spreads, 'impeccable three-year track record'; users must bridge from Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum or Base to Derive Chain, a 'semi-permissioned OP Stack rollup'; on-chain friction keeps it far behind Deribit.

sources.title: Unchained — Derive co-founder proposes 50% increase in DRV token supply (15 Sep 2025)
sources.excerpt: Community divided: supporters accept dilution for growth; critics call the mint a betrayal of holders and fear loss of investor confidence. Forster called the proposal 'aggressive'.
